data.name: VRTS
data.detailed_description:
VRTS takes your favorite elements from a space RTS, and puts them into VR! Watch as your ships battle it out in real time and really feel the impact the enemy has on your space station. 

[h1]Watch over the war table as mini battles happen before your eyes, and command your units for the best outcomes.

This game has no story, you are a commander of a fleet and you use your hands to look over the battle map infront of you to defeat the enemy ships. Find new interesting strategies when defeating your enemies. Upgrade your battle station in combat to unlock new bigger and stronger ships, but don't get too greedy or it could cost you the game!

Only one gamemode at the moment, Wave Defense. Defend your base and mine for credits to defend against the ever growing size of the enemy attackers. (EARLY ACCESS NOTE: The waves are finite at the moment, try to make it to the 17th wave!)

Soundtrack made by me! (Not made yet)

take on the galaxy in VRTS!

[/h1]

Controls: 

Left Grip: Pan Map
Left Trigger: Move left and right to zoom in and out of map

Left Primary Button: Open Inventory
Left Secondary Button: Pause Game

Left Joystick: Move

Right Grip: Grab Unit in inventory or select owned structure/ (In selection mode) Hold and drag while pointing at units to select them
Right Trigger: Interact with the UI (While holding Inventory unit, pull trigger to place unit in a valid spot)/(in selection mode) Order selected units

Right Primary Button: Switch Mode (from selection or placement)

Right Joystick: (pushed forward) telelport/(pushed left or right) rotate camera

data.short_description: VRTS is a VR Real-Time-Strategy game based in space! Command and construct a fleet of spaceships to defeat your enemies. Watch over the battle from your war table and make the ultimate strategy to bring down your adversary.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 / FX 8350
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 970 / AMD Radeon R9 290
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: N/A
  • VR Support: Should work with all VR headsets, but untested.
  • Additional Notes: Can't play without VR headset
